title: (RHBA-2018:2995) Update to Fuse 7.1.0 Images
portal_summary:
This update for the Red Hat Fuse 7.1.0 release of 'Fuse on OpenShift' and 'Fuse Online (Ignite)' images addresses the following Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) issues:
https://www.redhat.com/security/data/cve/CVE-2018-3136.html

https://www.redhat.com/security/data/cve/CVE-2018-3183.html

portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse on OpenShift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse Online (Ignite) images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

These images are intended for use with the following components:
* Red Hat Fuse version: 7.1.0.fuse-710019-redhat-00002
* Maven archetype version: 2.2.0.fuse-710017-redhat-00003

The base URL for the image streams and templates in this release is:
https://github.com/jboss-fuse/application-templates/tree/application-templates-2.1.fuse-710017-redhat-00006

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.1.0 on OpenShift, see the following section of the Fuse on OpenShift Guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.1/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/#patch-images
